Quantum 1.17.0 was certified on 2026-08-25. It pins **nucleus v1.12.0**, **quark v1.6.0** and **orbit v1.7.0**, with 5 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.16.0: orbit goes from v1.6.7 to v1.7.0 (minor), nucleus stays at v1.12.0 and quark stays at v1.6.0. No sibling module changes version.
